title: City Commission Meeting — Final Vote on Waterfront Moratorium
location: Commission Chambers, City Hall, 401 Clematis Street
description: Second-reading (final) vote on a proposed six-month moratorium on new planned development applications for the Flagler waterfront corridor (south of Monroe Drive, north of Southern Boulevard, west of Flagler Drive, east of Washington Road). Public comment is taken at Commission meetings.

title: 900 S Rosemary Hotel — City Commission Vote (Date TBD)
displayDate: Date not yet set — watch Commission agendas
location: Commission Chambers, City Hall, 401 Clematis Street
description: The Planning Board approved the proposed 18-story, 400-room convention-center hotel on June 16, 2026. Final approval by the City Commission is still pending and no hearing date has been set; the developer has said it intends to break ground in late August.
